'''Nad'alin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] aligned with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> they operated a stall in the [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi training grounds]] of the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] while it was [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|under attack]] by [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Flesh Raider]]s. While members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] defended the post, Nad'alin offered four training [[Sword/Legends|blades]] for sale: [[Apprentice's Light Foil]]s, [[Challenger's Blade]]s, [[Understudy's Blade]]s,  and [[Understudy's Light Foil]]s. The [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] had light skin, [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. At the outpost they wore a dark gray [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] with light gray pants and [[Boot/Legends|boots]].

==Behind the scenes==
Travin appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a weapons vendor at the Gnarls Outpost on Tython.<ref name="TOR" />
